original_publisher_years_protected: 2015/2016/2017 numeric data excluded by source adapter
adjacent_query: source-observed index at anchor-lag+1, known before anchor, wrong target
distant_query: source-observed index at anchor-lag+max(2, floor(lag/2)), known before anchor, wrong target
zero_intervention: hold original model/optimizer/source/encoder/writer/source input/matrix/bias constant; feed 16 exactly zero FP32 values to original trained historical_content decoder and predictive_memory_delta for current query only
primary_metrics: paired per-seed and per-lag authentic historical PM2.5 MAE, absolute change in decoded prediction vs read-zero and relative to other existing events, paired 120 source cases, original prior native checkpoint prediction identity
secondary_metrics: true versus wrong read/key cosine, mean 16D read L2, next-hour genuine PM2.5 forecasts by query type; current-value baseline
evaluation_order: all authentic source queries previously fixed and originally committed by PAR-MEM-011, not selected using labels
checkpoint_provenance: original 10 complete pretrained checkpoints frozen and SHA checked; no model weights are modified, no backprop, no GPU, no new training
scientific_scope: causal intervention on FROZEN inference computation conditional on already trained checkpoint; cannot identify whether original training had fair source generalization, cannot estimate missing-feature retraining potential; not independent virgin TEST
validation_gate: original native arm point predictions match precommitted original DEV arrays, clean checkout replay all intervention arrays and metrics
